'''Steamed golden carrots''' are the simple preparation of the [[Golden Carrot|golden carrot]], a secret [[ingredient]]. They heal {{Value|Steamed Golden Carrots|heals}} and grant {{EffectLink|Night Vision}} for {{Value|Steamed Golden Carrots|duration|effect=Night Vision}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/golden_steamed_carrots.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe is secret and is never added to the recipe book.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating them takes {{Value|Steamed Golden Carrots|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Steamed Golden Carrots|heals}} (through Regeneration IV instead of III) and gives Night Vision for {{Value|Steamed Golden Carrots|duration|effect=Night Vision|format=clock}}. Cooking them grants ''Hidden Flavors''.
